{
  "subject": "interior landscape",
  "main_subject": "a dining table set before a large window overlooking a lake",
  "lighting": "soft, diffuse natural light from the window; dim interior with a warm lamp on the table",
  "color_tone": "cool blue-green palette with a strong cyan/blue cast, low saturation overall",
  "contrast": "low",
  "issues": [
    "underexposed shadows in the foreground",
    "strong cool color cast (blue/cyan)",
    "low contrast and flat appearance",
    "muted and dull colors"
  ],
  "style_directions": [
    "warm up the white balance to remove the blue cast and create a cozy atmosphere",
    "increase exposure and contrast to brighten the room and add depth",
    "boost saturation slightly and add warmth for richer greens and wood tones",
    "consider a film-like or vintage look with muted highlights and warm shadows"
  ]
}
